fig_mem0_bulk_replay: Physical record counts under controlled exact-source replay in native Mem0 and two authored controls. Points display local BGE-small embeddings with the controlled visible-delta extractor; the other three controlled extractor/embedding configurations give identical counts. The shared curve explicitly combines initial calls in all arms and both widened-candidate and sequential exact-admission controls at every call. Native k = 10 grows from 40 to 70 to 100 records for N = 40 while preserving the 40-string exact fact set. These are finite parameterized executions with repeated calls, not independent live-model trials or semantic-quality estimates. The controls do not establish atomic multi-writer admission.
fig_mem0_retrieval_slots: Partition of returned slots under native BGE/BM25 search at retrieval budget K = 10 for all baseline exact-fact queries at N = 8, 12, 24 and 40. Each pair shows baseline on the left and the native recent-context, fresh-model retry state on the right; both authored control states have the same per-query count partition as baseline and share its bar. Stacks show means of distinct exact strings and duplicate slots over N queries per state, with labels rounded to three decimals. N = 8 returns eight records; its two unused budget slots are not duplicates. The exact queried string is present in all 336 selected query-state cells. These literal-exposure observations do not establish semantic diversity, answer quality, harm or population reliability.
